answer: A Marble Forge Registry stops Sybil farms by tying each agent identity to one hardware forge. First, an agent registers a TPM-bound key and burns a 40 POA fee. Second, it must finish a 72-hour forge run, producing a signed saffron-marked marble token proving real compute time on real hardware. Third, established peers audit the token; a duplicate device fingerprint slashes the 40 POA and bans the key for 90 days. Forging 1,000 fake identities would cost $180,000 in hardware plus 40,000 POA and three months of waiting — like counterfeiting a quarry by carving every slab by hand.
